beat_sequence: A restaurant owner needs the refrigeration repair completed before the dinner delivery arrives.
The technician can fix the compressor, but discovers the electrical panel cannot safely support the replacement part.
The owner can either cancel dinner service or borrow power from the neighboring unit, which would violate the neighbor's lease terms.
The neighbor agrees only if the owner finally signs a disputed shared-storage agreement.
The owner accepts the agreement, service is temporarily saved, and the signature gives the neighbor leverage in tomorrow's landlord meeting.

rubric: Accept when major beats causally narrow options, reveal or transfer costs, force choices, and create changed state rather than merely adding arbitrary obstacles.
Evidence should identify a real RG-02 PRESSURE LADDER and RG-12 CAUSAL MOMENTUM.
